rationale: Medical and maternal health context in Africa requires warmth, trust, and serenity. We avoid sterile clinical greys and childish pinks/teals, opting for grounded earthy tones that signify life and growth, remaining highly credible to ministries of health.

patient_portal.notes: Large tap targets (min 48px). Mobile-first. High contrast. Minimal UI noise.

professional_portal.notes: Dense UI, tight spacing, collapsible Shadcn accordions for 7-section CPN forms.

admin_portal.notes: Data-dense, bento grid for 19 KPIs, sticky filter bars, Recharts integration.

buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#C05C3D] border border-[#C05C3D] hover:bg-[#FDF2EF] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 transition-colors

cards.admin_kpi: bg-white rounded-lg border border-[#E5E1D8] p-4 flex flex-col gap-2

vaccine_timeline.description: Vertical timeline component for VAT1-5 and child vaccines

alerts.urgent: bg-[#D9381E]/10 text-[#D9381E] border border-[#D9381E]/20 p-4 rounded-lg
alerts.warning: bg-[#E59500]/10 text-[#E59500] border border-[#E59500]/20 p-4 rounded-lg

icons.usage: 24px for standard UI, 32px-48px for patient portal main actions, 16px for clinical data tables. No emojis allowed.

image_urls.description: Healthcare professional checking patient in clinic in Africa

pages.landing_page: Mission focused, highly credible, sober design. Includes Hero with mother & baby image, features cards for the 3 portals, professional credibility markers.
pages.login_page: Role selector (Patient vs Pro/Admin). Large friendly tap areas for patients, standard email/password form for pros.
pages.patient_dashboard: Mobile-first layout. Large 'Next Appointment' card. Vertical vaccine calendar (mother & child) with clear status colors. Danger signs reminders.
pages.professional_dashboard: High-density view. 'Today's Appointments' table, urgent alerts panel (high BP, term passed), fast search bar for patient lookup.
pages.patient_detail_cpn: Tabs for Profile, Grossesses, Vaccination, Postnatal, Documents. CPN contact form is a 7-section accordion (general, clinical, biology, prevention, vaccination, education, decision). Sticky 'Save' actions.
pages.admin_dashboard: Dense bento grid for 19 KPIs. Recharts (line/bar/donut) for coverage rates. Filters bar stickied at top. CSV Export buttons.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Avoid low contrast gray-on-gray in medical data.
accessibility.tap_targets: Minimum 48x48px on mobile views for patient portal.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='patient-login-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React (.js files, NOT .tsx).
Use pure Tailwind CSS and raw HTML tags for layout structures, applying generic components from Shadcn/UI ONLY where interactive logic is needed (e.g., Dialog, Tabs, Accordion).
Use lucide-react for all icons, no emojis.
Ensure 'recharts' is installed for Admin dashboard visualizations (Line, Bar, Donut).
Differentiate UI density strictly based on role: Patient (airy, large text, big touch targets), Pro (dense, tabular, fast data entry), Admin (analytical, complex charts).
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, form inputs, and key data points.
